column1: # IRS SOI Congressional District Data documentation guides: the sentence on the file's State totals and its footnote 2.

column2: State totals within the Congressional data may not be comparable to State totals published elsewhere by SOI because of disclosure protection procedures or the exclusion of returns that did not match based on the ZIP code. See footnote for complete State totals. [2]
column3: [2] For complete individual income tax tabulations at the State level, see the historic table posted to Tax Stats at http://www.irs.gov/uac/SOI-Tax-Stats---Historic-Table-2.
